about: The VisIVO VR headset app (issues #255, #383): a QR-code scanner (a 2-D panel) and the pairing loader packaged as an immersive Horizon OS app; the desktop's USB launch opens its backend's VR page instead. Read by build.sh / make-twa.py; the packages must match backend/app/vr_app.json. loaderOrigin + startPath is the page the scanner opens with the code (#pair=); its host must publish /.well-known/assetlinks.json for the app (web/vr-loader/.well-known/). Bump versionCode whenever the wrapper changes (a new Bubblewrap, a new patch, a new icon, a new loader; the icons are made by make-icons.py): the desktop reinstalls an app whose versionCode is lower than the one it ships.
